title: UPPERCASE lowercase
story: Your friend texts you in ALL CAPS and it feels like they're SHOUTING. What if your program could convert any message into a shouting voice or a whisper? With uppercase and lowercase functions, it can!
why: Converting text case is used everywhere � from standardizing usernames to formatting titles and fixing messy user input.
analogy: string.str_upper is like a megaphone for your text, and string.str_lower is like a quiet whisper.
try_it: Print your name in all caps and all lowercase. Then create a funny sentence, convert it to uppercase for SHOUTING, and lowercase for whispering. Print both!
tips: str_upper and str_lower only affect letters � numbers and punctuation stay the same!
The original string is never changed � these functions return a brand new string
Combine with str_concat to build formatted messages like titles or greeting cards
common_mistakes: Expecting the original variable to change � `string.str_upper(name)` returns a new string, it doesn't modify `name` itself
